samples.question: The image is a 2D field of random black speckle on a white background. A single 1D glyph is hidden purely in the column of the ink: each column holds an independent vertical scatter of dark pixels whose count traces a smooth profile across the picture (a peak, two humps), but because they are scattered at random heights the raw raster looks like shape-less speckle. Declared transform: add up the black ink in every column to get a 1D profile. If the profile is one central peak, the answer is A; if it is two symmetric peaks, the answer is B. Answer A or B.
